target.title: fix(cli): deliver pre-tool assistant blocks durably
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

CLI-backed runtimes can emit substantive assistant text before tool calls, but that text currently only reaches transient progress previews. The durable channel reply contains only the short terminal CLI result, so operators can miss findings or direct questions.

Fixes #110067.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Reuse the CLI parser's existing pre-tool text classification instead of adding a second parser or provider-specific path.
- Route completed pre-tool assistant blocks through the existing block-reply handler only when block streaming is enabled.
- Force-flush each completed block from its own commentary callback so delivery does not depend on a later tool event.
- Start the existing preamble progress lane first, run durable delivery independently, and wait for both lanes to settle so a failure in one cannot suppress the other.
- Leave the tool-event callback and block-streaming-disabled behavior unchanged.

## User Impact

With block streaming enabled, CLI users receive substantive pre-tool assistant prose as durable channel messages instead of losing it when the final CLI result is only a short wrap-up. The existing transient preamble lane remains available, and the final CLI result is still returned normally.

## Evidence

- Added regression cases for block-only delivery, dual progress/durable delivery, durable-lane failure isolation, and final-result preservation.
- `oxlint` passed for both changed files.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- OpenClaw `autoreview` completed cleanly after the CI-driven revision with no accepted/actionable findings (0.96 confidence).
- The first full CI run caught an event-order regression and missing delivery-handler test setup; both were corrected. The [full updated GitHub Actions suite](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29604153436) passed at head `0b85660b4d17`, including CI, CodeQL, OpenGrep, workflow sanity, and platform periphery checks.
- [Redacted CLI-backed channel runtime proof](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110119#issuecomment-5006805713) shows an actual OpenClaw Gateway with block streaming enabled and a real CLI subprocess durably sending the pre-tool block before the terminal result. The recorded channel operations contain exactly two sends—one pre-tool and one terminal—with no edits, deletes, or duplicate result.

## AI Assistance

This change was implemented with Codex assistance. Codex inspected the issue and current source path, authored the implementation and regression tests, diagnosed the first CI failure, ran formatting/static checks, completed the repository's structured autoreview, and exercised the patched runtime through a CLI-backed inbound channel harness. No agent transcript is attached.
